title: Comprehensive Analysis of 175 SPARC Galaxies Demonstrating Regime-Dependent Validity in Rotation Curve Modeling
abstract: Comprehensive regime-dependent validity analysis of 175 SPARC galaxies. Models achieve 100% success in low-complexity FLOW regime but systematically fail in high-complexity LATENT regime. Regime separation is statistically significant (Mann-Whitney U, p < 0.0001).
